description: Resolve every actionable review finding on PR #56 for issue #54 production hardening. Add regression tests, run umbrella and demo quality checks, commit, push to the existing PR branch, and recheck review and CI status.

comments.text: Review has three actionable findings. Plan: block non-idempotent mutation retries for 5xx outcomes in ProviderResponse and Error; retain strict schemas while projecting handler output to declared fields before validation; store PreparedAction integration IDs as strings so load does not depend on the atom table; add regression tests and run all required checks.

Implemented all three PR #56 review fixes. Focused tests passed (26 core, 14 Jira). Full umbrella mix quality passed. Demo format check, warnings-as-errors compile, and 21 tests passed. Commit recorded on the PR branch.
Fresh review findings: require secure Jira endpoints, preserve OAuth gateway paths when resolving REST URLs, and prevent preview key normalization collisions from replacing trusted metadata.

Implemented the three fresh-review fixes. Jira rejects HTTP endpoints, Jira Client uses absolute operation URLs that preserve OAuth gateway prefixes, and provider preview reserved keys are dropped after transport-key normalization. Focused tests pass (15 core and 10 Jira).
Second fix commit recorded. Full mix quality passed. Demo format check, warnings-as-errors compile, and 21 tests passed.
Normalized stored ProviderResponse transport reasons so Req.TransportError timeout values participate in retry guidance. Added read and idempotent-write regressions; focused tests pass.
Third fix commit recorded. Full mix quality passed. Demo format check, warnings-as-errors compile, and 21 tests passed.

title: Address PR 56 review findings
